# "Built with the hubverse" — community projects powered by hubverse tools/data.
#
# To add a project, copy an entry into the `projects` list and fill in:
#   name        project name
#   org         team / institution behind it
#   description one concise sentence on what it does
#   url         project website or repository
#   img         screenshot/logo shown on the left of the card (path under /includes/img/)
#
projects:
  - name: RespiLens
    org: UNC Chapel Hill / ACCIDDA (Atlantic Coast Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics and Analytics)
    description: "RespiLens is a responsive web app to visualize respiratory disease forecasts in the US, focused on accessibility for state health departments and the general public"
    url: https://www.respilens.com/
    img: /includes/img/respilens.svg
  - name: MicroHubs
    org: Northern Arizona University
    description: "MicroHub is a local forecasting dashboard that helps public health teams upload surveillance data, run infectious disease forecast models, compare results, and export hub-ready probabilistic forecasts."
    url: https://sjfox.github.io/microhub-workshop/
    img: /includes/img/microhub.png
